html:
The National Eligibility Cum Entrance Test (NEET), Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Mains, and JEE Advanced are competitive exams held annually in India for admission to undergraduate medical and engineering programs.

The dates for these exams are typically announced by the National Testing Agency (NTA), the organization responsible for conducting the exams, several months in advance.

NEET is a national-level exam held for admission to medical and dental colleges in India. It is typically held in May or June. For NEET 2023, NTA has announced that the exams will be conducted in the pen and paper mode on May 7. Students clearing NEET (UG) entrance exam qualify for top-tier medical institutions such as AIIMS and JIPMER for courses such as BDS, MBBS, BUMS, BAMS etc.

JEE Mains is an entrance exam for admission to undergraduate engineering and architecture programs in India. It is held twice a year, in January and April. The first session of JEE Mains 2023 will be held on January 24, 25, 27, 28, 29, 30, and 31, followed by Session 2 on April 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12.

JEE Advanced is the second stage of the JEE exam and is held for admission to the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs). It is typically held in May or June, a few weeks after JEE Mains. The top 2,50,000 aspirants who clear JEE Mains appear for this exam. As of now, the NTA has not announced the dates yet, but tentatively speaking, the exam is expected to be conducted by the third week of June 2023.

It is important to note that the dates for these exams may change from year to year, and it is always a good idea to check the official website of the NTA for the most up-to-date information.

Students planning to take these exams should start preparing well in advance, as they are highly competitive and require a significant amount of preparation. This includes reviewing the syllabus and practicing past exam papers to get a feel for the types of questions that are asked.

In conclusion, the dates for the NEET, JEE Mains, and JEE Advanced exams in 2023 have not yet been announced. It is always a good idea to check the official website of the NTA for the most up-to-date information and to start preparing well in advance for these competitive exams.

Registering and filling the NEET 2023 application form

The NEET 2023 application form is released on the official website of NTA - neet.nta.nic.in. Registrations on the portal tentatively start from the first week of April 2023. Below are the steps given to fill the application:

  • Visit the official NTA NEET 2023 website and click on the ‘New Registration’ tab
  • Fill in basic details like name, DOB, email, contact number etc., and submit
  • You will get login credentials (ID and Password) and registration will be completed
  • Fill the NEET 2023 application form by providing personal details, specifying the exam centre and medium, and academic details
  • After filling details documents need to be uploaded such as passport-size photograph, academic certificates, category certificates, signature, thumb impressions, etc. in JPEG and PDF formats
  • Once done, the NEET application fee has to be paid via UPI, debit card, credit card, net banking, or e-wallet

Registering and filling the JEE Main 2023 Online Application Form

Here are the steps you need to follow to fill out the JEE Main 2023 application form, kindly note that this is solely an online process and NTA does not accept any forms that are not submitted online.

  • Go to the official website - jeemain.nta.nic.in - for applying and click ‘Apply Online’
  • Fill up the application form
  • Select New Registration and enter basic details such as your name, phone number, email address, DOB, category, academic details, and exam centre preference
  • Once done, kindly upload scanned copy of required documents in a specific format and size. Make sure to meet all the technical requirements to avoid rejection of your application
  • Pay the application fee through online or offline mode
  • Submit your application form
  • After submission you will see a confirmation page. Take a printout for reference later on
  • A provisional registration number will be sent on your registered mobile number and email following due process
